title: Monitor currency exposure/hedge currency
goal: Each currency's exposure is measured including invoices and bills already issued, set against the limit the treasury rules allow, and any cover the venture holds was decided and transacted by the founder.

steps.do: Total the exposure in each currency, cash held plus invoices owed to the venture plus bills it owes, and show what a ten percent move either way would do to the cash position.

consider.why: An invoice already issued in another currency is an exposure before anyone converts anything.
consider.when: The venture holds, bills or pays in more than one currency.

steps.do: Set each currency's exposure against the limit the treasury rules allow and name every one over it, with how far over it is and how long it has been.

consider.why: An exposure only means something against the limit someone set for it.
consider.when: The venture has treasury rules that set a limit on currency exposure.

steps.do: Set out the ways to reduce the exposure, invoicing in the venture's own currency, holding a balance in the other one, matching receipts against payments or buying cover, with the cost of each, and hand it to the founder, who decides and transacts.

consider.why: Most currency exposure can be removed by changing how the venture invoices rather than by buying anything.
consider.when: An exposure is over the limit the rules allow.

steps.do: Raise each exposure over its limit as a decision for the founder with the options and their cost, tell the finance lead which would hurt the runway first, and record on the handoff when the venture deals in one currency only.

done_criteria.check: Does each currency's exposure include invoices and bills already issued as well as cash held, and was any cover decided and transacted by the founder?
